plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Papouch TH2E temperature and humidity monitors (PEN 18248.20) with optional TME temperature scalar (PEN 18248.1). TH2E inChValue is scaled by /10; rows still measuring or in measurement error are dropped; dew-point channel 3 is skipped; Fahrenheit and Kelvin readings are converted to Celsius. Limit status is normalized so in-limits is healthy and high/low is fault. DisplayString temperature leaves are not collected.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: env_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Papouch temperature in degrees Celsius from TH2E inChValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.18248.20.1.2.1.1.2) scaled by /10 and converted from Fahrenheit or Kelvin when inChUnits requires it, or from optional TME int_temperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.18248.1.1.1.0) scaled by /10. Dew-point rows and not-yet or error statuses are dropped.

metrics.name: env_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Papouch TH2E relative humidity in percent from inChValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.18248.20.1.2.1.1.2) scaled by /10 when inChUnits is percent or the channel index is 2. Not-yet or error statuses are dropped.

metrics.name: env_temperature_limit_state
metrics.description: Papouch TH2E temperature-channel inChStatus normalized so in-limits (0) is healthy and above or below limit (2 or 3) is fault. Not-yet (1) and measurement-error (4) rows are dropped.

metrics.name: env_humidity_limit_state
metrics.description: Papouch TH2E humidity-channel inChStatus normalized so in-limits (0) is healthy and above or below limit (2 or 3) is fault. Not-yet (1) and measurement-error (4) rows are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
